adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new logic iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when a matching credential is not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } ... })` inside the loop. This is a diff-verifiable per-destination DB query pattern (potential N+1) and batching with a single `findMany` for all missing `destination.credentialId`s up front would avoid repeated roundtrips. It’s a performance/efficiency concern rather than an immediate correctness defect.
